unit.title: Linux Process Boundaries: Build and Test a Bounded Command Runner

catalog_basis.ordering_claim: This topic was selected as a practical kickoff; the catalog does not establish it as the first official module.

unit.scope: One local, defensive software-engineering lab about process invocation, bounded I/O, timeout cleanup, tests, and operational evidence.
learning_objectives: Model the trust boundary between a caller, an argument vector, and a child process.
Implement bounded subprocess execution without shell interpretation.
Handle concurrent output, timeouts, process-tree cleanup, and reporting as explicit states.
Use deterministic tests and captured evidence to support engineering claims.
Explain how algorithmic invariants differ from operating-system and API guarantees.

unit_completion_requires: All learner deliverables named in STUDY_TASK.md are present.
A worker-controlled examiner checks behavior with independent harmless fixtures.
The implementation, tests, evidence, design explanation, and comprehension responses satisfy the independent rubric.
